people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.
translations.bsb: So they set it aside until morning as Moses had commanded, and it did not smell or contain any maggots.
translations.kjv: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm
translations.asv: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not become foul, neither was there any worm therein.
